title: serializeGQLSchema omits MORE_TYPES notice when a root operation type is truncated
body:
While looking through the AI chat GraphQL schema serializer in `packages/hoppscotch-common/src/helpers/aichat/context-serializers.ts` (lines 47-67 on `main` commit `e633b55`), I noticed that when a root type (`Query`, `Mutation`, or `Subscription`) exceeds `max = Math.min(rootBudget, room())` and gets clipped via `add(truncateText(printed, max - TRUNCATED.length))`, `truncated` is not set to `true`.

If the remaining non-root types in `schema.getTypeMap()` fit within the remaining budget, `if (truncated) parts.push(MORE_TYPES)` at line 65 is skipped even though the root type definition was truncated (and in `truncateText` on lines 19-24, if `max < 0` is ever passed, `value.slice(0, cut)` slices from the end of `value`). Should `truncated = true` also be set in the `else if (max > TRUNCATED.length)` branch? Happy to send a quick PR if that sounds right!
